battle.name: 拉普蘭戰爭
battle.brief: 拉普蘭戰爭始於1944年9月，德國軍隊與芬蘭及蘇聯軍隊在芬蘭拉普蘭地區交戰，戰事延至1945年。戰中的德軍砲兵使用婆塞德後膛砲（Breech-loading cannon，1870年），這款早已列裝的後膛重砲在戰役中承擔火力支援與據點防衛任務，並支援部隊作戰。

kit.name: 婆塞德後膛砲
kit.history: 婆塞德後膛砲屬德軍後膛砲兵系統，是一八七〇年已列裝的舊式重砲，可用於野戰及要塞防禦，並在第二次世界大戰砲兵編制中提供曲射火力。

countries: 拉普蘭戰爭的正式交戰國是芬蘭與納粹德國，戰區集中在芬蘭北部的交通走廊，而非全國戰線。芬蘭方面由第三軍團司令海爾馬爾・西拉斯沃負責北部作戰，下轄第十五集團軍，核心包括第三師、第十一師與第二十一旅；從奧盧沿海岸北上的第六師封住托爾尼奧入口，遠在東方庫薩莫一線的第十四師則負責切斷德軍北撤走廊。德方由駐挪威軍及其拉普蘭部隊應戰，主要作戰單位是庫爾特・塔佩瑟少將指揮的第196山地獵兵團，另有其他戰鬥、警衛與後勤分隊加入北撤序列。芬、德控制或爭奪的地點包括托爾尼奧、凱米、羅瓦涅米、索丹屈萊、埃嫩特基奧、庫薩莫、薩拉，以及連接這些城鎮的公路、鐵路、橋梁和車站。蘇聯不是此役的直接交戰方，但蘇軍在卡累利阿與北芬蘭方向的戰略進攻，以及莫斯科停戰協定的壓力，構成了迫使芬蘭改變對德作戰方向的外部條件。
countriesEn: The formal belligerents in the Lapland War were Finland and Nazi Germany, and the fighting was concentrated along the transport corridors of northern Finland rather than across the entire country. On the Finnish side, Lieutenant General Hjalmar Siilasvuo commanded the northern theatre through the Third Corps. His principal formation was the 15th Army, built around the 3rd and 11th Divisions and the 21st Brigade. The 6th Division advanced north from Oulu to seal the approaches to Tornio, while the 14th Division in the far east around Kuusamo was assigned to cut the German withdrawal route. Germany responded through its Army of Norway and the Lapland Force. Its principal combat formation was the 196th Gebirgsjäger Regiment under General Kurt Tappesser, supplemented by combat, security, and service detachments joining the northward withdrawal. The contested places included Tornio, Kemi, Rovaniemi, Sodankylä, Enontekiö, Kuusamo, and Salla, together with the roads, railways, bridges, and stations connecting them. The Soviet Union was not a direct belligerent in the Finnish-German clashes, but its strategic advance in Karelia and northern Finland, together with the pressure of the Moscow Armistice, forced Finland to change its policy toward Germany.
people: 最高政治層的轉變發生在1944年9月。芬蘭總統里斯托・呂蒂領導的政府最初不接受莫斯科停戰條款，議會亦於9月22日表態拒絕；9月25日，尤霍・庫斯蒂・帕西基維出任總理，改組內閣並授權北部軍區解除德軍武裝。曼納海姆元帥仍保有最高軍事指揮權，但拉普蘭的日常作戰由西拉斯沃自主處理；這位軍團司令決定不把解除武裝變成單純談判，而是以封路、殲滅德軍後衛和迫使投降並行。埃爾基・耶埃斯克萊寧以第十五集團軍指揮官身分推進托爾尼奧至羅瓦涅米一線，維爾約・考皮拉指揮第十一師，庫爾特・馬爾蒂・瓦萊紐斯指揮第三師，保羅・蘇西泰瓦爾率第六師從奧盧北上，埃諾・蘇奧拉赫蒂則指揮第二十一旅。尤西・西赫沃率第十四師執行「白樺行動」，在東方切斷退路。德方由洛塔爾・倫杜利克上將以駐挪威軍最高指揮官身分決定優先保存兵力並向挪威撤退；維佩特・馮・布呂赫大使代表德方傳達要求，卻未能改變德軍不投降的決定。塔佩瑟負責第196團的撤離，1944年12月底在圖恩察一帶的埃格特少校則在包圍完成後率所部投降。
peopleEn: The decisive political change occurred in September 1944. President Risto Ryti's government initially rejected the terms of the Moscow Armistice, and the Finnish parliament also voted against accepting them on 22 September. On 25 September, Juho Kusti Paasikivi became prime minister, formed a new cabinet, and authorized the northern military authorities to disarm the German forces. Marshal Mannerheim retained overall command authority, but operational control of the Lapland campaign rested with Siilasvuo, who decided that disarmament would be enforced through road blockage, attacks on German rearguards, and pressure for surrender rather than negotiation alone. Erkki Jääskeläinen directed the 15th Army along the Tornio-Rovaniemi axis; Viljo Kauppila commanded the 11th Division, Kurt Martti Wallenius the 3rd Division, Paavo Susitaival led the 6th Division north from Oulu, and Eino Suolahti commanded the 21st Brigade. Jussi Sihvo led the 14th Division in Operation Birke, cutting the eastern escape route. For Germany, Generaloberst Lothar Rendulic, commander of the Army of Norway, prioritized the preservation of his forces and withdrawal toward Norway. Ambassador Wipert von Blücher conveyed German demands but could not alter the decision not to surrender. Tappesser directed the withdrawal of the 196th Regiment, while Major Eggert capitulated with his surrounded force near Tuntsa in late December 1944.
kits: 芬軍步兵的標準裝備包括莫辛-納甘 M/31 系列步槍、德造 Kar 98k 步槍、Suomi KP/-31 衝鋒槍、TT-38 手槍，以及拉赫提-薩洛蘭塔 M/26 輕機槍；這些武器使小分隊能在近距離森林、雪坡和村落間迅速轉移。芬軍炮兵可使用 76 K/31 野戰砲、120 Kr/36 迫擊砲、150 K/39 榴彈砲和 37 K/36 反戰車砲。砲彈與迫擊砲彈由後方鐵路運到奧盧、托爾尼奧及羅瓦涅米，再以載重卡車、馬匹雪橇和人工背運分送前線；較重的 150 公厘榴彈砲仍需拖曳，無法像輕型迫擊砲那樣迅速越過積雪道路。德軍步兵裝備包括 Kar 98k、Gewehr 43、MP 40，晚期北撤分隊亦配用 Sturmgewehr 44，機槍則有 MG 34 與後來的 MG 42。其連屬火力包括 8 cm Granatwerfer 34 迫擊砲、10.5 cm leFH 16 榴彈砲與 15 cm sFH 18 重型榴彈砲，面對橋頭、路口和雪地陣地時能形成深密火力；Panzerfaust 與 Panzerschreck則用於反擊近距離裝甲車及車隊。芬軍使用 Ford V8、GAZ-AA 與 Sisu SA-213 系列載重車，德軍北撤縱隊常見 Opel Blitz 輕型卡車及 Mercedes-Benz L 1500。雙方都依賴毛皮內衣、白色雪地罩衣、手套、ski、固定式雪鞋與防滑冬靴，並用雙馬或單馬雪橇運送糧食、燃料及傷員。漫長補給線、車輛故障、燃料短缺和冬夜失溫，比單純的射程差距更常決定這些縱隊的命運。
kitsEn: The standard Finnish infantry load included the Mosin-Nagant M/31 series rifle, German-supplied Kar 98k, Suomi KP/-31 submachine gun, TT-38 pistol, and Lahti-Saloranta M/26 light machine gun. These weapons allowed small formations to move rapidly through forests, snow-covered slopes, and settlements at close range. Finnish artillery included the 76 K/31 field gun, 120 Kr/36 mortar, 150 K/39 howitzer, and 37 K/36 anti-tank gun. Shell and mortar ammunition was carried by rail to depots at Oulu, Tornio, and Rovaniemi, then distributed forward by trucks, horse-drawn sledges, and porters. The heavy 150 mm howitzer still had to be towed and could not cross snowbound roads as easily as the lighter mortars. German infantry were equipped with the Kar 98k, Gewehr 43, MP 40, and, in the later withdrawal columns, Sturmgewehr 44; machine-gun strength came from the MG 34 and later the MG 42. Battalion and regimental artillery included the 8 cm Granatwerfer 34, 10.5 cm leFH 16, and 15 cm sFH 18, which could produce dense fire against bridgeheads, road junctions, and snowfield positions. Panzerfaust and Panzerschreck were used against vehicles and armored cars at close range. Finnish transport relied on Ford V8, GAZ-AA, and Sisu SA-213-series trucks, while German columns commonly used Opel Blitz light trucks and Mercedes-Benz L 1500 vehicles. Both sides depended on fur-lined clothing, white snow camouflage, mittens, skis, fixed snowshoes, and winter boots. Horse-drawn sledges carried food, fuel, and casualties. The decisive material problems were the long supply routes, mechanical failures, fuel shortages, and exposure during long winter nights rather than a simple difference in weapon range.
tactics: 芬軍的戰術重點不是沿整條德軍縱隊平行追趕，而是先奪取道路節點、橋梁、鐵路車站與渡口，使德軍失去連續撤退所依賴的時間。西拉斯沃把北部戰區分成數條相互支援的推進軸線：第十五集團軍沿托爾尼奧至羅瓦涅米的公路和鐵路推進，第六師由奧盧側擊托爾尼奧方向，第十四師則以「白権行動」向庫薩莫至薩拉公路展開。1944年10月初的托爾尼奧戰鬥中，芬軍先遣分隊進入車站與港區外圍，主力以 76 K/31 野戰砲和 120 Kr/36 迫擊砲封鎖道路；德軍利用碼頭建築、橋頭和彎道設置短暫據點，以 MG 42、迫擊砲及工兵爆破掩護後隊北撤，芬軍則在突破道路阻礙後切斷其與後方縱隊的聯絡。十月中旬的耶利托爾尼奧與穆奧尼奧一帶道路狹窄，橋梁與村落構成瓶頸，芬軍一面砲火壓制德軍後衛，一面繞過個別據點，避免在線性道路上正面消耗。德軍則採連續撤退與局部阻延，MG 42火力封鎖彎道，迫擊砲支援步兵脫離，Panzerfaust伏擊落單車輛，並在撤退時破壞橋梁、鐵路和通信設施。芬軍第十四師及第二十一旅在東方把退路切成數段，再以平行公路向薩拉和圖恩察壓進；圖恩察的德軍被限制在積雪盆地與有限道路上，芬軍以步兵攻擊結合迫擊砲及野戰砲火逐步消滅其陣地，12月28日埃格特少校率殘部投降。1945年1月至2月，芬軍沿主要公路搜索殘餘德軍、封閉邊境出口並接收投降小隊，而非把戰役延伸成對挪威的進攻。
tacticsEn: The Finnish operational method was not to run parallel to the entire German column, but to seize road junctions, bridges, railway stations, and river crossings so that the Germans would lose the time required for a continuous withdrawal. Siilasvuo divided the northern theatre into several mutually supporting axes. The 15th Army advanced along the Tornio-Rovaniemi road and railway, the 6th Division pressed toward Tornio from Oulu, and the 14th Division opened Operation Birke against the Kuusamo-Salla road. During the fighting for Tornio in early October 1944, Finnish advance detachments entered the outskirts of the station and harbour while the main force used 76 K/31 field guns and 120 Kr/36 mortars to seal the roads. The Germans occupied short-lived strongpoints around harbour structures, bridges, and bends, covering their withdrawal with MG 42s, mortars, and engineer demolitions. Once the Finns broke through these obstacles, they cut the Germans off from the columns behind them. The roads around Ylitornio and Muonio were constricted by bridges and settlements in mid-October. The Finns combined artillery suppression with bypass movements instead of repeatedly attacking along the narrow frontage. Germany used a sequence of withdrawals and local delaying actions: MG 42s covered the bends, mortars assisted disengagement, Panzerfaust ambushes struck isolated vehicles, and engineers demolished bridges, railways, and communications during the retreat. In the east, the 14th Division and 21st Brigade cut the withdrawal route into separate segments and advanced along parallel roads toward Salla and Tuntsa. At Tuntsa, the German force was confined to a snow-covered basin and a limited road system. Finnish infantry attacks combined with mortar and field-gun fire progressively reduced the positions, and Major Eggert surrendered the remnant on 28 December. From January into February 1945, Finnish formations searched the principal roads for remaining German troops, closed border exits, and received isolated surrendering groups without extending the campaign into Norway.
data: 關鍵日程顯示戰役如何由停戰轉為全面軍事衝突。1944年9月19日，芬蘭與蘇聯等國簽署莫斯科停戰協定；9月22日芬蘭議會表態拒絕接受條款，9月25日帕西基維組閣並把解除德軍武裝交給北部軍區。10月初，第十五集團軍等部向托爾尼奧一線進逼；10月8日，芬軍向當地德軍提出繳械要求，隨後奪取托爾尼奧，戰鬥集中在車站、港區及周邊道路。德國於10月15日正式向芬蘭宣戰，使原先的停戰執行變成明顯的國家間戰爭。10月中旬，德軍撤離羅瓦涅米時破壞鐵路、橋梁、站房與供應設施，並縱火焚燒城區；其縱隊分別沿托爾尼奧附近的海岸公路，以及索丹屈萊、埃嫩特基奧、基爾皮斯耶爾維方向北撤。耶利托爾尼奧與穆奧尼奧的戰鬥發生在同月中旬，之後芬軍把追擊線拉長至北向公路與東方戰區。11月至12月，第十四師執行「白権行動」，第二十一旅參與庫薩莫、薩拉方向的包圍；12月28日，圖恩察的德軍指揮官埃格特少校率數百名所部投降，這是末期最大規模的整批投降。1945年1月至2月，芬軍搜索公路、清除孤立據點並封閉通往挪威的出口，最後一批有組織的德軍或散兵於2月被處理，戰役通常以1945年2月為終點。交戰雙方都投入一萬餘量級兵力，但實際到場、撤退中、後勤及重複計算使精確總數難以核實。至於死亡、凍傷、失聯與被俘數字，各方統計基準不同且記錄不完整，因此不能把彼此矛盾的總數視為可靠定論。
dataEn: The chronology shows how the armistice dispute became a full military conflict. On 19 September 1944, Finland signed the Moscow Armistice with the Soviet Union and the other parties. On 22 September the Finnish parliament voted against accepting the terms, and on 25 September Paasikivi formed a cabinet and assigned the disarmament of the German forces to the northern command. In early October, the 15th Army and associated formations advanced toward Tornio. On 8 October the Finns demanded that the local Germans surrender their weapons, then took Tornio after fighting around the station, harbour, and approaches. Germany formally declared war on Finland on 15 October, turning the enforcement of the armistice into an overt state of war. In mid-October, the Germans evacuated Rovaniemi while destroying railway lines, bridges, station buildings, and supply installations and setting fire to much of the built-up area. Their columns withdrew along two principal systems: the coastal road through the Tornio area and the route through Sodankylä, Enontekiö, and Kilpisjärvi. Fighting at Ylitornio and Muonio followed in the same middle part of the month, after which Finnish pursuit lines extended along both the northern road and the eastern theatre. From November into December, the 14th Division conducted Operation Birke, while the 21st Brigade took part in the encirclement around Kuusamo and Salla. On 28 December, Major Eggert and several hundred members of his command surrendered at Tuntsa, the largest organized surrender of the late campaign. During January and February 1945, Finnish troops searched the roads, cleared isolated positions, and closed the exits toward Norway. The last organized German formations or stragglers were dealt with during February, and the campaign is conventionally dated to the end of February 1945. Both sides committed forces on a scale of more than ten thousand, but differing definitions of troops present, withdrawals, rear-area personnel, and duplicated counting make exact totals uncertain. The same problem affects published totals for dead, frostbite cases, missing, and captured, so mutually contradictory figures should not be treated as settled statistics.
cause: 拉普蘭戰爭的根本原因是芬蘭、德國與蘇聯的戰略關係在1944年發生逆轉。莫斯科停戰協定要求芬蘭停止對蘇聯的戰鬥，並在1944年底以前把德軍逐出芬蘭；同一組條款還涉及芬蘭交出佩察莫及租借波爾卡拉。芬蘭已無力獨力維持對德作戰，蘇軍又在卡累利阿、北芬蘭及其他方向持續推進，因此接受停戰並解除德軍武裝是政府與軍方共同面對的軍事必要。芬蘭不能容忍德軍把撤退變成長期佔領，也不能讓北方道路、港口和物資繼續由德方控制。德的拒絕則源於自身的軍事考量：北撤挪威可以保存拉普蘭部隊、裝備與部分北方基地，卻必須經過芬蘭控制的交通線；若接受全部停戰條款，德國將失去在芬蘭的戰略位置。因此，德方一面準備向北轉移，一面拒絕無條件繳械，並決定在撤退時破壞設施。芬軍最初的解除武裝行動遂與德軍的走廊保衛及撤退發生直接碰撞。這不是孤立事件引發的偶然衝突，而是停戰義務、外交談判破裂、北方地理限制和雙方軍事目標同時作用的結果。
causeEn: The fundamental cause of the Lapland War was the reversal of the strategic relationship among Finland, Germany, and the Soviet Union in 1944. The Moscow Armistice required Finland to cease fighting the Soviet Union and expel German troops from Finnish territory by the end of 1944; the wider settlement also involved the transfer of Petsamo and the lease of Porkkala. Finland no longer possessed the strength to continue the war against the Soviet Union on its own, while Soviet forces were advancing in Karelia, northern Finland, and other sectors. Accepting the armistice and disarming the Germans therefore became a military necessity for the Finnish government and army. Finland could not allow the German withdrawal to become a prolonged occupation, nor could it leave the northern roads, ports, and supplies under German control. Germany refused because its own strategic interests pointed northward. Withdrawal toward Norway offered a means of preserving the Lapland troops, their equipment, and some northern bases, but it depended on transport corridors controlled from Finland. Full acceptance of the armistice terms would cost Germany its strategic position in the country. The Germans consequently prepared to transfer their forces north, refused unconditional disarmament, and intended to destroy useful installations during the withdrawal. The original Finnish attempts to disarm German troops therefore collided directly with German efforts to secure the corridor and continue the retreat. The conflict was not an accidental clash generated by a single local incident; it resulted from the armistice obligations, the breakdown of negotiations, the constraining northern geography, and incompatible military objectives.
impact: 戰役首先改變了雙方在北歐的軍事處境。德國失去芬蘭北部的前進基地、倉庫、道路與大量可繼續使用的裝備，拉普蘭部隊只能被壓向挪威並投入北挪防務；原本可供芬蘭與德國共同使用的北向交通帶，轉而成為兩軍彼此阻隔的地帶。芬蘭則恢復對北部主要城鎮、鐵路和公路的直接控制，完成莫斯科停戰中最艱難的軍事條款。這個結果不等於德軍在芬蘭被完全消滅，因為相當一部分兵力、武器與車輛成功撤往挪威，但它使德國無法再把芬蘭當作北向作戰的支柱。戰役也加重芬蘭自身的人力、燃料與冬季補給負擔，長距離追擊、封路和守備包圍圈使第三軍團必須分散砲兵與後勤。基礎設施遭受嚴重破壞，羅瓦涅米大部分城區、沿途站房、橋梁、鐵路、通信線與供應倉庫在撤退和戰鬥中受損，北部城鎮之後需要重建。政治與軍事層面上，芬德之間原有的軍事合作正式終止，芬蘭北部指揮體系也由共同對蘇作戰轉為執行停戰與排除德軍。蘇聯仍是停戰安排的主要受益方，但芬蘭的形式主權得以保留，北方領土沒有因德軍撤退而落入任何交換條件。
impactEn: The campaign immediately altered the strategic position of both sides in northern Europe. Germany lost its forward bases, warehouses, roads, and substantial quantities of usable equipment in Finland. The Lapland forces were pushed toward Norway and absorbed into the defense of northern Norway; a northward transport system once available to both Germany and Finland became a zone separating the two armies. Finland recovered direct control of the principal northern towns, railways, and roads and completed the most demanding military clause of the Moscow Armistice. This did not mean that the German army in Finland was annihilated, because a substantial part of its personnel, weapons, and vehicles reached Norway successfully. It did, however, prevent Germany from retaining Finland as a base for operations in the north. The campaign also increased the Finnish burden of personnel, fuel, and winter logistics. Long pursuit routes, blocking operations, and the defense of encirclement lines forced the Third Corps to distribute artillery and sustainment across wide distances. Infrastructure suffered severely: much of Rovaniemi's built-up area, together with railway stations, bridges, communications lines, and supply depots along the withdrawal routes, was damaged during the fighting and evacuation. Reconstruction of the northern towns and transport system became a postwar necessity. At the political and military level, Finnish-German military cooperation formally ended, and the Finnish northern command structure changed from joint operations against the Soviet Union to the enforcement of the armistice and the removal of German troops. The Soviet Union remained the principal beneficiary of the armistice framework, but Finland retained formal sovereignty, and no northern territory was exchanged as part of the German withdrawal.
result: 就芬蘭明確設定的有限目標而言，結果是成功的。芬蘭第三軍團迫使德軍放棄托爾尼奧至羅瓦涅米的控制，奪取北向公路和東方退路，於1944年12月28日迫使圖恩察的德軍整批投降，並在1945年2月前清除境內最後的成建制德軍與主要散兵。芬軍沒有追入挪威，而把行動限制在完成莫斯科停戰所要求的解除武裝與領土清剿；戰役結束時，芬蘭北部的主要城鎮、道路、鐵路與邊境出口均由芬方控制。德的北方基地計畫失敗，大量裝備與時間在撤退中損失，但主體部隊仍成功撤往挪威，因此這不是一場全滅式的戰役。芬軍也付出高昂而難以精確統計的代價，傷亡、凍傷、失聯與俘獲數字因雙方記錄缺口而存在明顯分歧，不宜引用單一精確總數。從戰略結果看，芬蘭履行了停戰協定的核心義務，保住了北部領土的實際控制，並切斷德國繼續利用芬蘭的途徑；德國則未能在 Finnish territory 建立持久存在，卻仍保存了部分兵力撤退至北挪。拉普蘭戰爭因而以芬蘭的有限而明確勝利告終，其最直接的結果不是任何一方全軍覆沒，而是德軍在1945年2月離開芬蘭，北部戰區的軍事權力完成轉移。
resultEn: In terms of the limited objective Finland had set for itself, the result was a success. The Finnish Third Corps forced the Germans to relinquish control of the Tornio-Rovaniemi corridor, seized the roads leading north and the escape routes in the east, compelled the German force at Tuntsa to surrender in large bodies on 28 December 1944, and eliminated the last organized German troops and most remaining stragglers before the end of February 1945. The Finns did not pursue into Norway; they confined the campaign to the disarmament and territorial clearance required by the Moscow Armistice. At its conclusion, the Finns controlled the principal northern towns, roads, railways, and border exits. Germany's plan for a northern foothold in Finland failed, with much equipment and time lost during the withdrawal, but the main body of the German forces still reached Norway, so this was not an annihilating victory. Finland also incurred heavy costs that cannot be stated with precision. Casualty, frostbite, missing, and prisoner totals differ because both sides left incomplete records, and no single exact aggregate is reliable. Strategically, Finland fulfilled the central military obligation of the armistice, retained effective control of its northern territory, and cut Germany off from further use of Finnish territory. Germany could not preserve a lasting military presence there, although it saved part of its force in northern Norway. The Lapland War therefore ended in a limited but unambiguous Finnish victory. Its direct result was not the destruction of either entire army, but the departure of the Germans from Finland by February 1945 and a final transfer of military power in the northern theatre.
